main.description: One change to a file or folder, written with the node change it records. The record key is a TID made when the change was. It holds the node's state after the change (nothing after a delete), and the version the change was based on.

node.description: Record key of the node (me.jsnelgro.atdrive.node) that changed.

device.description: The device that made the change.

prev.description: Record key of the version this change was based on: the node's current version as the device last saw it. Absent for a node's first version. Two versions with the same prev are a race.

name.description: After the change (absent after a delete): the node's name.

parent.description: After the change: the folder it's in. Absent for the top level.

contentsFrom.description: Files: record key of the version holding this state's chunks, when this one doesn't (a rename or move, or a restore).

chunks.description: Files: the contents, when this version holds them. Referencing them keeps the blobs for as long as the version is kept.
